comment:
Quote: "The researchers first disaggregated the intake data into
one dataset for orphans and one for non-orphans at each
school with each assigned a random number using the
RANUNI function in SAS. Within each list, records were
sorted in ascending order by the random number and
numbered sequentially. Those with odd and even
sequential numbers were assigned to the intervention
and waitlist groups, respectively"; "Survey
interviewers were masked to participants’ treatment
allocation."
